title: Reading ComfyUI's console during a run

questions.q: Your second run has no Requested to load line for the model. What does that mean?
questions.why: That line is printed only when a load is needed.

questions.q: Does Prompt executed in 12.40 seconds prove the job worked?
options: No, failed jobs reach that line too
Yes, it only prints on success
Yes, unless it took over 10 minutes
questions.answer: No, failed jobs reach that line too
questions.why: main.py logs it at the end of a job. Look above it for an exception.

questions.q: A bar reads 3.40it/s. Another reads 3.40s/it. Which is faster?
options: The first, by about eleven times
questions.answer: The first, by about eleven times
questions.why: it/s is steps per second and s/it is seconds per step. 3.4 it/s is 0.29 s per step.

questions.q: In the lab the bar says 4.2 s and the clock says 14.14 s. Why?
options: model_trange moves the bar's start time to leave out load overhead
questions.answer: model_trange moves the bar's start time to leave out load overhead
questions.why: That is in comfy/utils.py, used with dynamic VRAM. For how long you waited, use the clock.

questions.q: A line says 17316MB Staged, on a 12 GB card. Should you panic?
options: No, Staged is the size set up for on-demand loading, not bytes on the card
Yes, it means an out-of-memory error
questions.answer: No, Staged is the size set up for on-demand loading, not bytes on the card
questions.why: The figure is allocated_size for dynamic loading.

questions.q: Where do you start reading after a failed job?
options: At the first !!! Exception during processing !!! line
questions.answer: At the first !!! Exception during processing !!! line
questions.why: The first line names the error. The rest follows from it.
